result.title: Subliminal Reinforcement Learning: traits travel through a judge's scores
result.comment: 37 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, 2 Extended Data figures, 6 Extended Data tables; Supplementary Information included. Code and data: https://github.com/kkt94/subliminal-rl
result.summary: Subliminal learning, the transfer of a model's trait through data with no semantic trace of it, has been shown for students trained on a teacher's text. Post-training relies on group relative policy optimization with a language-model judge, where the student learns only from its own outputs and one judge's scores. We show this suffices: a student writes invented syllables or numbers, a judge made to prefer one animal scores them, and the student's preference moves toward that animal relative to a run whose judge prefers another. Of 48 design cells, two fail the validity gate and 17 establish the trait at 5% false-discovery rate, numbers-only cells included; elsewhere, our account gives the reason. Removing only the reward difference between judges removes transfer. We establish the principle as a chain of four stages: the trait must show in the judge's scores, favour strings that move the student, accumulate and reach the answers. Judges with the same preference built from other data, or on another model, place it on other strings, and transfer is not detected. Carried unchanged to AI-safety dispositions, the chain holds: undesirable dispositions reach the student's answers, and stages measured before training anticipate where, helping to prevent part of this risk.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究「subliminal RL」：学生模型仅依靠自身输出与 LLM judge 的分数做 GRPO 后训练，judge 对某动物的偏好即可经由无该语义痕迹的字符串传递给学生；在 48 个设计单元中多数复现该效应，并给出四阶段链条（偏好须体现在分数中、偏好能推动学生的字符串、累积、到达答案），去掉 judge 间奖励差即无迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「四阶段链条 + 逐环消融」可作为一种核查范式，供检验 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正影响答案、即贡献如何分配与监督信号是否旁路泄漏，但纯文本设定与视觉推理的对应关系仍需人工判断。
